title: Publieke opinie over krijgsmacht en defensie 1982
authors: Meulen, J.S. van der, Stichting maatschappij en krijgsmacht * Den Haag (primary investigator)
contributors: Stichting maatschappij en krijgsmacht * Den Haag (research initiator)
Nederlands instituut voor de publieke opinie en het marktonderzoek, NIPO * Amsterdam (data collector)
descriptions: Study of public opinion concerning actual themes of military force and defense. Necessity and quality of army / war and peace / quality of soldiers / necessary freedom for soldiers / professional, voluntary and compulsory service / NATO and Warsaw- pact / East-West detente / arms reduction / nuclear weapons / neutron bomb / role United States in defense of Europe. Background variables: basic characteristics/ residence/ occupation/employment/ income/capital assets/ politics/ religion/ organizational membership
